acquisition: Acquire count basis, positive rational representation, legal measurement family, support/prefix services, and any phases needed for coherent compilation. N46's full-algebra trace-covering net is a separate acquisition.
alignment: N42/N96 can supply positive probabilities or coherent preparation for specified count events/pins. N46 concerns a single EB channel on a full algebra. A narrow overlap exists only when the legal experiment and losses factor through an acquired diagonal count algebra.
assumptions: The input family is block-diagonal in the acquired count basis and every admissible loss/measurement factors through that basis.
The positive kernel/prefix representation covers the entire induced label law uniformly over inputs, not only one herald or pin.
The claim is restricted to this measurement algebra; arbitrary POVMs, purification, and independent-copy preservation are excluded.
cost: Charge photon energy/cutoff, event parameters and relative counting (N42), support/prefix counts, phases and reversible circuit cost (N96), and uniform label-law error. For full N46, additionally charge full-algebra net/channel construction.
falsifier: Two states with identical count laws but distinct expectations under an allowed off-diagonal measurement; or a faithful growing family with small marginal broadcast error and large EB error, as permitted by N61. N98 also blocks promotion from trace closeness to relative purity control.
missing_lemma: Show that replacing the original output by the sampled count label changes every legal risk by at most eps uniformly. To claim full N46 reconstruction, construct an EB channel on the full algebra and prove uniform trace-norm error.

reciprocity.forward: Positive count sampling yields a restricted EB/classical reconstruction only when all legal statistics factor through count labels.
reciprocity.reverse: An EB reconstruction from N46 transfers to an N42/N96 positive count sampler only if it preserves/acquires the exact count representation and supplies relative weights, zero detection, and any coherent phase/prefix services; EB existence alone gives none.

scope: Restricted diagonal experiment hypothesis. It does not establish full-algebra intrinsic classicality or any purity/entropy guarantee.
